Subject: Thanks for signing up — pick a 30m slot

Hi Alex —

Thanks for signing up and welcome to Redwood Inference! Quick next step: pick a 30-minute slot with one of our engineers so we can walk through your use case and the fastest way to get a POC running.

Choose any open slot here: https://redwood.ai/schedule/slot?token=abcd1234
(We keep a few engineer-only slots each week for developer-led trials.)

High-level agenda (30m):
- 5 min intros and objectives
- 10 min quick architecture + model/latency goals
- 10 min demo of relevant flows (inference + cost controls)
- 5 min next steps / mutual action plan

If none of the times work, reply with a few windows that do and well coordinate.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0197

P.S. If you have a teammate who should join, include them on the reply and well send a joint invite.
